description: Submit the production-access application questionnaire for a personal developer account. Only possible once the closed-testing tester/day requirement is met (see setup_closed_testing and get_setup_state). All ten answers are the developer's own words about their testing — never invent them. DRY-RUN BY DEFAULT.

app_value_or_uniqueness.description: What the app offers users (free text).

commit.description: "true" submits. Omit or "false" for a dry run.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

intended_audience.description: Who the app is for (free text).

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

production_readiness_decision.description: Why the app is ready for production (free text).

tester_engagement.description: How testers engaged with the app (free text).

tester_recruitment_methodology.description: How testers were recruited (free text, the developer's own words).

testing_induced_changes.description: What changed as a result of testing (free text).

name: submit_prod_access_application
